entries.name: decision_corpus
entries.estimand: choice-set structure, physical-run integrity, and split isolation of the v11 decision resources
entries.does_not_prove: This structural audit does not establish predictor accuracy, deployment utility, label reliability, or prospective generalization.
entries.supported_claim: Published pairs are context-consistent physical-run siblings with same-budget train/frozen isolation inside the audited release.

entries.name: source_opportunity
entries.estimand: retention boundary plus parent-linked identity and journal-status coverage for generated siblings absent from the labeled release
entries.supported_claim: The release is a labeled sibling fragment with a high-coverage, parent-linked registry of missing generated identities and statuses.
entries.does_not_prove: The registry does not recover missing numeric outcomes, establish missing-at-random, make the labeled fragment a complete choice set, or demonstrate a censor-aware selector's utility.

entries.name: decision_observability
entries.estimand: finite-population child-slot and declared undirected sibling-pair capacity through source, raw, finite, and published release stages
entries.supported_claim: In the audited 3,252-parent release, 14.61 percent source child-slot loss corresponds to 38.51 percent declared pair-capacity loss; the comparison-resolution loss is material in both train and frozen roles.
entries.does_not_prove: Declared C(n,2) capacity is not a log of comparisons made by the agent, all audited parents retain a finite published decision, and the census does not recover a complete labeled choice set or establish predictor accuracy, search utility, missing-at-random, or causality.

entries.name: status_certified_partial_order
entries.estimand: provenance-certified validity-dominance relation coverage among natural same-parent MLE-agent source candidates
entries.supported_claim: The release contains 2,079 explicit status-certified validity edges; the stricter execution-error-only subset retains 2,060 edges and passes every original material and support gate.
entries.does_not_prove: Validity dominance is not a numeric-quality total order, unresolved relations remain unknown, and the release does not establish a complete choice set, missing-at-random, predictor accuracy, search utility, or algorithmic novelty.

entries.name: source_decision_answerability
entries.estimand: fraction of all frozen natural source-parent choice sets for which the released provenance-bound partial order certifies a unique winner
entries.supported_claim: Published finite orientations certify 2,344 of 3,252 source winners; status-certified validity raises this to 3,001, adds 657, and reaches a 0.9228167281672817 all-parent answerability rate.
entries.does_not_prove: Source-winner answerability is not predictor accuracy, search utility, a complete numeric total order, or a prospective effect; transitive relations are implications of the released partial order rather than logged agent comparisons, and identity-unavailable parents remain unanswered.

entries.name: label_repeatability
entries.estimand: repeatability of pair ordering under independent regrades and model-based transport over score-gap distributions
entries.does_not_prove: Repeatability is not empirical predictor accuracy and the transported quantity depends on the explicitly recorded exchangeability and symmetry assumptions.
entries.supported_claim: Pair ordering is highly repeatable on the independently regraded ten-task subset under the recorded regrade protocol.

entries.name: normalized_clone
entries.estimand: cross-run and cross-task shallow code-clone incidence under preregistered tokenizer and AST normalizations
entries.does_not_prove: The token result covers 99.91 percent and the AST result 97.25 percent; neither excludes fuzzy, semantic, or training-data duplication, and the preregistered aggregate strong gate failed on AST coverage.
entries.supported_claim: No cross-run or cross-task duplicates were observed among endpoints covered by the preregistered token and AST normalizations.

entries.name: deployment_cost
entries.estimand: single-pair online query latency and initialization cost relative to recorded pair execution runtime
entries.does_not_prove: This experiment does not compute frozen accuracy or show that a particular selector improves search score or wall-clock time.
entries.supported_claim: The audited lightweight predictors have online query latency far below recorded candidate execution time under the pinned CPU protocol.

entries.name: evidence_provenance_repair
entries.estimand: which machine evidence pointers retain strict zero-prediction-value provenance after the prediction-matrix incident
entries.supported_claim: The value-reading coverage matrices, their v6 catalog entry, the v1 task-balance chain, and affected ABC crosswalk pointers are preserved as historical-withdrawn. V7 is rebuilt from unaffected v5 and binds only replacement receipt-only or structural-only evidence.
entries.does_not_prove: Withdrawal does not prove every historical number wrong, does not delete the audit trail, and cannot retroactively repair v1 provenance.

entries.name: prediction_receipt_common_support
entries.estimand: receipt-certified equality of the canonical structural-pair population reconstructed by frozen WL and transition independent verifiers
entries.supported_claim: At immutable snapshot 8579, the two frozen verifier chains independently certify the same 2,755-pair canonical population. The join opens no pair prediction file and accesses no prediction value.
entries.does_not_prove: Receipt equality does not reopen pair identity or orientation and does not support tie, margin, activation, accuracy, effect, utility, runtime, or first-960 closure claims.

entries.name: structural_weighting_shift
entries.estimand: how chronological physical-run task weights are transformed into derived sibling-pair benchmark weights by task-specific opportunity yield
entries.supported_claim: At the 339-run 7cda prefix, run-to-pair task-weight TV is 0.337082500713674. Run HHI fell while pair HHI rose; the direction is temporally persistent and task-deletion robust, and opportunity yield explains most of the measured HHI/TV shift.
entries.does_not_prove: The shift is not observed predictor bias or effect. One drop explains 0.9641733656841007 of the pair-HHI change, so robust magnitude and causal producer-behavior claims are forbidden.

entries.name: opportunity_yield_aggregation_audit
entries.estimand: a closure-time decomposition of run-to-informative-pair aggregation into structural opportunity yield and informative retention
entries.supported_claim: Before closure, the two-stage decomposition, full task-universe gate, common-support gate, range-times-TV bounds, and no-rescue reporting rule were frozen and independently checked.
entries.does_not_prove: This is an interpretation contract, not a measured predictor effect; it cannot supersede a frozen primary, rescue a failed primary with alternate weighting, or claim informative-cluster-size theory as novel.

entries.name: task_balance_structural_only_v2
entries.estimand: forward accounting of a frozen structural-pair task-balance debt using only snapshot-bound accumulator summaries, ledgers, structural gates, and receipt-only total-count certification
entries.supported_claim: From 2,635 to 2,755 pairs, frozen debt changed from 657 to 645 exactly because dominant/non-dominant increments were 27/93. The debt improved by 12 but remains uncleared.
entries.does_not_prove: The current 0.308529945553539 dominant share still fails the 25% cap and dominant pairs accrued before debt clearance, so producer compliance, causal acquisition effect, predictor effect, and v1 provenance repair are forbidden claims.

entries.name: prospective_gate
entries.estimand: outcome-blind accrual and structural eligibility state of the preregistered first-960 confirmatory cohort
entries.does_not_prove: The cohort is incomplete and outcomes remain sealed; this entry is not a prospective accuracy or mechanism result.
entries.supported_claim: The preregistered confirmatory cohort is accruing outcome-blind and remains sealed until its run target and independent closure are met.
